title: Security Deposits: December 31 Interest Accrual on a Cash Deposit Held in Full
content:
Cash Security Deposits earn interest by the calendar year. This policy posts the December 31 accrual of a calendar year on a cash deposit that was held in full for the whole of that year; a year in which installments posted is accrued tranche by tranche under the interest rules.

## What the policy governs

- **Subject:** a cash deposit record held in full throughout a calendar year whose December 31 accrual has not yet been posted on its deposit ledger.
- **Result governed:** the interest amount of that year's December 31 accrual, with its accrual period, rate and days counted.
- **Business effect:** an interest accrual entry on the deposit ledger for the year, and an increase of the interest accrued and not yet paid out on the deposit record.

## Booking function

`post_year_end_deposit_interest_3b717487` is an agent-side function: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Capability.** It posts the December 31 interest accrual of one calendar year on a cash security deposit. One call writes one interest accrual entry dated today on the deposit's ledger with the accrual period, the annual rate, the days counted and the interest amount, and adds that amount to the interest accrued and not yet paid out on the deposit record. The member sees the year's interest on the deposit.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `deposit_account_id` | the reference number of the security deposit record, as returned by the deposit record lookup for the member | identifier text |
| `accrual_period_start` | the first day of the accrual period | a date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `accrual_period_end` | the last day of the accrual period | a date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `interest_rate_pct` | the annual interest rate applied, in percent | 2 decimal places; 2.07 means 2.07 percent |
| `accrual_days` | the number of days of the period on which interest is counted | an integer |
| `amount` | the interest accrued for the period, in USD | a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` ("accrued" on success), `deposit_entry_id` (reference number of the new ledger entry), `deposit_account_id`, `accrual_period_start` and `accrual_period_end` (YYYY-MM-DD), `interest_rate_pct` (percent, 2 decimal places), `accrual_days`, `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places) and `accrued_interest` (interest now accrued and unpaid on the record, USD, 2 decimal places).

**Contract note.** The function records the period, rate, days and amount it is given; it does not work them out.
